The call had come late in the night, a stormy night upon the plains. [Tavaag](https://i.sli.mg/Ftcq7g.jpg) had slipped from her tent, and stealthily made her way through the camp. The clan had camped in a small dell for the past week. The hunting had been good, they had killed a number of [Ekwins](https://i.sli.mg/Kuyinz.jpg). But the real reason the clan had stopped, was Savaag.

The poor girl had lain with a Loner. A clanless rogue, without family or name, without honour. The soft had no family, the soft cared only for themselves. The loner had done what loners do, and left. He had left poor Savaag with a belly full of pups. Idiot girl. To make matters more complicated, The Hunter had arrived that evening. An ill omen to be sure.

The birth had been complicated. Tavaag had worn the mantel of Shaman for many years. She had birthed hundreds of pups, but she had never seen anything like this. One pup. Only one pup had survived out of a litter of nine. The seed of the loner had been soft, and so had Savaag, for she had bled out. Poor girl, poor soft girl. The pup itself had seemed different, it's fur grey, not brown. It had seemed larger to Tavaag, but it mattered not. Without a mother to nurse it, the pup would surely die. So Tavaag gathered the sorry babe, for it would fall to her. A quick death is kinder than the pain of starving to death. It was a sad day.

Tavaag left the tent, and a ghost cast a shadow upon her. A [hooded figure](https://i.sli.mg/myH9mY.jpg) stood in the rain, outside the tent. The Hunter. "Give the child to me" she said. Tavaag hesitated, a shiver running up her spine. [She held the pup closer](https://i.sli.mg/MTBhQ5.png), a sudden urge to protect it, gripped her. The Hunter extended her hands, and Tavaag gave up the child. "What is its name?" Said the Hunter.

"We do not name those who never lived" replied Tavaag. The Hunter cast a cold look upon her. "This child will live", said the Hunter. "Give me its name, it deserves to be named by its clan." Tavaag shook her head, for surely this child will die. But the Hunter asked for a name, and so she gave it one. "Saag" she said. The Hunter spat. "Soft" she smirked. "This child will be anything but." The Hunter turned, and strode off into the night. A shadow blending into a sea of darkness, clutching a newborn babe to her chest.
